array.port_orientation: acoustic ports face up (+Z), package rotated so its long axis is tangential
array.pairing: adjacent channels 2k/2k+1 share one DATA net; even channel L/R=GND, odd channel L/R=VDD

clocking.fanout: SN74LVC244APWR, one input net driving 8 series-terminated branches, one branch per microphone pair

power.source: Raspberry Pi P1 pins 2 and 4 (5 V) only
power.input_protection: JK-MSMD050-30 PTC (0.5 A hold) then SS14 Schottky, blocking Tang USB-C back-feed into the Pi

rails.+5V: board input, feeds Tang Nano 9K 5 V header pin and the LDO
rails.+3V3_CLK: +3V3A through a ferrite bead, supplies the oscillator and clock buffer
rails.TANG_3V3: Tang Nano 9K 3.3 V output, used only as the ESD clamp rail reference

host.target: Raspberry Pi Model B (2012), 26-pin P1 header
host.pins_used: only pins identical on Model B revision 1.0 and revision 2.0
host.connector: 2x13 2.54 mm shrouded IDC, hand-soldered, bottom side

fpga_module.mounting: two hand-soldered 1x24 2.54 mm female sockets on the bottom side
fpga_module.banks_used: 3.3 V banks only; J6 positions 2-9 are the 1.8 V bank and are left unconnected
